# Inventory Coordinator Continuity Brief

Outgoing coordinator for a Merkato retail counter. Focuses on daily stock checks, WhatsApp reorder messages, and coordinating with the warehouse supervisor by role.

## Recurring tasks
- Open the shop inventory notebook and count fast-moving items before 9am
- Send restock requests to the warehouse supervisor by WhatsApp
- Update the handwritten price board when supplier costs change

## Tools and systems
- Shop inventory notebook
- WhatsApp Business for supplier and warehouse coordination
- Calculator app for margin checks

## Decision points
- Reorder when fewer than one box of a fast-moving item remains
- Escalate supplier delays to the shop owner if stock will run out within two days

## Shortcuts
- Keep a pinned WhatsApp note with the top 20 SKUs and usual pack sizes

## Coordination
- Warehouse supervisor for restock timing
- Shop owner for price changes above 10%

## Common failure modes
- Forgetting to log evening sales leads to false stockouts the next morning
- Mixing lookalike SKUs when counting under rush conditions

## Onboarding checklist
- Shadow one morning count and one evening close
- Practice drafting a restock WhatsApp using role titles only
- Review the pinned top-20 SKU list before the first solo shift
